messages:
Alice Nguyen: Nightly eval just flagged a big regression for the multi-turn dialogue promptset — model:redwood-v2-int8-canary showing severe diversity drop. 12/16 prompts now return short "I don't know" / repeated tokens. Anyone on call?
Clara Mendes: Seeing same on the dashboard: https://redwood.internal/evals/nightly/1998765432 : diversity score down 0.37 -> 0.12 vs baseline. Most failures are >1k total tokens (long multi-turn).
Brian O'Connor: I rolled the new runtime kernel selector to canaries last night (optimize-packed-kv branch). Could be related.
Frank Rios: Pasting a bad output example from prompt #7:
```
User: Tell me what happened at the meeting and next steps.
Model: I don't know. I don't know. I don't know. I don't know. I don't know.
```
Clara Mendes: Also seeing repeated phrase with slight token jitter. Not typical hallucination — more like stale KV / failing context retrieval.
DeployBot: canary-deploy redwood-v2-int8-canary -> success (deploy id: dpl-9921) :tada:
Emma Li: We should consider immediate rollback if this impacts prod traffic. Any evidence this also affects hosted (non-canary) infra?
Brian O'Connor: Only canary pool has the selector enabled. Hosted stable model variants are unaffected for now.
Hannah Park: Can we run a quick canary rollback? Frank/Clara, take lead on triage while we rollback.
Frank Rios: Starting rollback for redwood-v2-int8-canary -> redwood-v2-int8-preview (previous runtime kernels). Will update.
DeployBot: rollback-deploy redwood-v2-int8-canary -> redwood-v2-int8-preview completed (dpl-9929).
Alice Nguyen: Ok rollback complete, nightly diversity recovered to 0.35 (intermediate). We still need root cause before re-promoting.
Clara Mendes: I ran a narrow repro harness hitting long multi-turn sequences. Found two correlated signals:
- tokenization mapping changed for some control tokens in the preprocessing patch (PR #4218) — caused rare token ID shifts for tokens near vocab boundary.
- packed-KV stride handling in the new runtime path assumes aligned strides for int8 kernels; with the token ID shifts we hit an off-by-one index when context length > 1024, producing stale KV reads.
Brian O'Connor: The kernel selector picks packed-kv layout for int8 to reduce memory. The stride index was calculated as `stride = (seq_len + kv_block - 1) / kv_block` but integer rounding logic was wrong for non-divisible sequences — PR incoming.
Frank Rios: Repro snippet (local harness):
```
# repro loop
for seq in [800, 1024, 1280]:
  out = run_model(prompt_long, seq)
  check_diversity(out)
```
At 1280 we see repeated tokens and identical KV hashes across steps.
Clara Mendes: Also saw tokenizer debug: `token_id(\u00a0)` returned 50288 on new tokenizer vs 50289 on old tokenizer for certain input with soft-space. Small shift cascades into packing layout.
Emma Li: Severity: high for canary. Impacted: canary-only, long-context evaluation, risk if promoted -> production. Action: block canary promotion and enforce gating.
Alice Nguyen: Agreed. Proposed mitigations:
- Immediate: Keep rollback in place (done). Add canary gating rule to disallow int8-packed-kv kernels for models until multi-turn diversity >= 0.3 on nightly.
- Medium: Hotfix PR to fix stride calc + add alignment checks in runtime (owner: @briano). Add tokenization regression test to tokenizers CI to catch boundary ID shifts (owner: @clara).
- Long: Extend nightly evals to include multi-turn dialogues up to 4k tokens and add diversity/coherence thresholds. Add alerting on sudden diversity drops (>=30% relative).
Brian O'Connor: Filing runtime fix PR: github.com/redwood/runtime/pull/2417 — includes stride fix and extra asserts. Will target canary branch, but block re-enable until eval passes.
Clara Mendes: Filed tokenizer PR tests in tokenizers repo: github.com/redwood/tokenizers/pull/112. Also adding a small fuzz test for non-breaking spaces and edge boundary tokens.
Hannah Park: Created a gating policy: GATE-ML-INT8-001 to require nightly diversity and multi-turn coherence pass before any auto-promotion. Assigned to @alice and @clara for verification.
Emma Li: Added an SLO guardrail on deploys: if nightly-alert triggers for diversity drop, auto-pause promotions + notify on-call.
Frank Rios: QA plan: re-run old and new harness across seq_len [512,1024,1536,2048] with 50 seeds, measure diversity and repetition rate. Will post results tomorrow.
Alice Nguyen: Owner/tickets summary:
- Runtime stride bug: runtime PR #2417 (owner Brian O'Connor)
- Tokenizer boundary test: tokenizers PR #112 (owner Clara Mendes)
- Gating rule: GATE-ML-INT8-001 (owner Alice Nguyen)
- Nightly eval extension + new alert: EVAL-1998 (owner Frank Rios)
Please ack and add if I missed anything.
Brian O'Connor: Ack. I'll also add extra logging for packed-KV stride values to make future root cause easier to trace.
Clara Mendes: Ack. I'll coordinate with infra to re-run the extended eval after PRs merge.
Emma Li: Thanks everyone. Marking incident as mitigated (canary rollback + gating). Will follow up if any regression surfaces in hosted.
Alice Nguyen: Thanks team — follow-ups on the tickets. We'll only re-enable the new kernel after the full eval pass and a canary soak. :white_check_mark:
Hannah Park: Filing retro note for postmortem doc, will assign to Frank to draft the root cause + timeline.
